paper_overview.sets_note: MPBSE typically 4 sets: A, B, C, D. Har set mein same questions hote hain, sirf order alag hota hai. Set number cover page pe zaroor likho.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: Hindi ya English dono valid hain. Hindi version final mana jaata hai agar discrepancy ho.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: Sab 23 questions compulsory hain. Q6 se Q23 mein internal OR choice milta hai — dono options mein se EK attempt karo.
paper_overview.ncert_enough: NCERT (Contemporary India II, India and the Contemporary World II, Democratic Politics II, Understanding Economic Development) compulsory hai. Previous year papers aur sample papers bhi zaroori hain.

question_types_in_exam.summary: Social Science MPBSE Class 10 paper mein 23 questions hain. Q1-Q5 objective type (30 sub-questions, 1 mark each). Q6-Q17 very short answer (2 marks each). Q18-Q20 short answer (3 marks each). Q21-Q22 long answer (4 marks each). Q23 map question (4 marks). Total 75 marks.

types.how_to_attempt: Options mein se correct answer choose karke option letter (a/b/c/d) aur answer likho.
types.mostly_from: Har saal Q1 mein Earth Summit (1992), water projects, crop types, HDI, Gandhi's book — ye topics repeat hote hain.

types.how_to_attempt: Factual one-word ya short phrase answers likhna hai. Chapter facts yaad rakho.
types.mostly_from: MGNREGA (100 days), Sri Lanka independence (1948), agriculture = primary sector, federalism, Rinderpest — ye common fill-in-the-blanks hain.

types.how_to_attempt: Statement padhke True ya False likho. Statement carefully padhna — words jaise 'always', 'never', 'only' pe dhyan do.
types.mostly_from: Constitution mein koi ek national language nahi, India federal system hai, Haldia = subsidiary port of Kolkata — ye true/false mein frequently aate hain.

types.how_to_attempt: Column A ke item ko Column B ke sahi item se match karo. Answer clearly likho like: a-(iii), b-(v) etc.
types.mostly_from: RBI = formal source of credit, Print media = social issues & news, Republican Party = USA, Labour Party = Britain — ye pairs repeat hote hain.

types.how_to_attempt: Ek sentence ya ek word mein answer do. Lengthy explanation nahi chahiye.
types.mostly_from: HDI = UNDP releases. WTO aim = free trade. Civil War = internal armed conflict. Bhai Bhonsle = Maratha chief. 'O Mor Apunar Desh' = Jyotiprasad Agarwala — ye Q5 mein aate hain.

types.how_to_attempt: 30 words = 2-3 sentences. Do clear points likhna hai — lengthy paragraphs nahi. OR option mein se jis par zyaada confident ho woh choose karo.
types.mostly_from: Q6-Q17 mein sab subjects se questions aate hain — Geography, History, Polity, Economics. Dono OR options padhke easier wala select karo.

types.how_to_attempt: 75 words mein well-organized answer do. 3 clear points ya 2-3 paragraphs. Q18 mein diagram wala question (soil profile) bhi aa sakta hai — diagram banana seekho.
types.mostly_from: Q18 = often soil profile / soil types / environmental degradation. Q19 = forest act / biodiversity / basic industries. Q20 = political parties reform / democratic governance.

types.how_to_attempt: 120 words = introduction + 3-4 key points + conclusion. Structured paragraphs mein likho. Headings ya bullet points se clarity aati hai.
types.mostly_from: Q21 = Road vs Rail transport comparison / sea ports of India (Geography). Q22 = First World War + Indian nationalism / Civil Disobedience Movement women participation (History).

types.how_to_attempt: Map mein clearly dot/star mark karo. Name ke saath mark karo. Geography OR History mein se ek option choose karo.
types.mostly_from: Mumbai High, Raniganj, Ennore, Digboi — ye map questions mein har saal aate hain. Inhe map pe practice karo.

most_scoring_sections: Easy — agar basic facts yaad hon toh 25+ marks easily milte hain. Ye section sabse scoring hai.
Easy-Medium — 30 words limit mein concise answer. OR choice se aasaan wala milta hai.
Easy — agar map practice ki ho toh 4/4 marks pakke.

tips: Q1-Q5 mein 30 marks hain — ye sabse zyaada scoring section hai, carefully attempt karo
Q6-Q17 mein har question mein OR option hota hai — dono padhkar easier wala choose karo
Q23 map mein OR choice hoti hai — Geography ya History mein se jis ka map zyaada practice hua ho woh choose karo
Soil profile diagram yaad karo — Q18 mein har saal kisi na kisi form mein aata hai
Road vs Rail transport comparison ke 4 points pakke yaad karo — Q21 mein repeat hota hai
Simon Commission, Dandi March, Quit India — inke 2 points pakke yaad karo
RBI match pair, Republican Party=USA, Labour Party=Britain — ye guaranteed marks hain
Fill blanks: MGNREGA=100 days, Sri Lanka=1948, Agriculture=primary sector — must remember
Long answers mein word limit 120 words — count karke rakho
Set number, roll number cover page par likhna mat bhoolna
MCQ mein answer ke saath option letter clearly likho

time_allocation.note: 30 min — carefully padhke attempt karo. MCQ mein process of elimination use karo.
35 min — 2-3 min per question. 30 words = 2-3 sentences. OR option mein aasaan wala choose karo.
20 min — 6-7 min per question. Diagrams Q18 mein clearly banao.
20 min — 10 min each. Structured points mein likho.
10 min — carefully mark karo. Name + location dono likho.
5 min — set number, roll number, word limits check karo

targets.strategy: Q1-Q5 objective section (20-25 marks almost pakke agar basic facts yaad hon). Q6-Q8 mein se 2-3 questions (4-6 marks). Total = 24-31 marks easily.
focus_areas: Q1 MCQ — basic facts: HDI, Earth Summit 1992, Paddy = main crop, Hind Swaraj
Q2 fill blanks — MGNREGA 100 days, Sri Lanka 1948, agriculture = primary sector
Q3 True/False — power sharing, federal system, modern money
Q4 Match — RBI, Republican Party=USA, Labour Party=Britain, Electronic Capital=Bengaluru
Q5 one sentence — easy factual answers

targets.strategy: Objective section full (25-28 marks) + Q6-Q12 mein se 6-7 questions (12-14 marks) = 37-42 marks.
focus_areas: Full objective section Q1-Q5 (30 marks attempt)
Q6 — forest conservation movements / forest importance
Q7 — millets / commercial crops / alluvial soil

targets.strategy: Objective (28+) + Q6-Q17 most questions (18-20 marks) + Q18-Q20 (6-9 marks) + Q23 map (2-3 marks) = 54-60 marks.
focus_areas: Q18 — soil profile diagram / soil types (3 marks — diagram + description)
Q21 — Road vs Rail comparison (4 marks)
Q22 — Simon Commission / Dandi March explanation
Q23 — Map (Mumbai High, Raniganj, Ennore practice karo)

targets.strategy: All 23 questions attempt with full preparation. Long answers mein structured writing aur vocabulary se extra expression marks milte hain.
extra_focus_areas: Q21 — Detailed point-by-point comparison (Road vs Rail, OR water/air transport)
Q22 — Detailed 4-point explanation with dates and events
Q23 — Accurate map marking — both options practice karo
Q18 — Soil profile diagram clearly drawn and labelled
All OR options padhna — jis par zyaada confident woh select karo

exam_day_rules.extra_time_note: 3 ghante fixed. Bell bajte hi answer sheet submit karni hoti hai.

answer_sheet_rules: sequence_note: Jo question aasaan lage pehle karo. But question number clearly likho.
word_limit_note: Word limits strictly follow karo — 30/75/120 words. Zyaada likhne se marks nahi badhenge.
map_rules: Map mein clear dot/star se location mark karo. Name clearly likho alongside.
partial_marking_note: Agar 2 mein se 1 point sahi ho toh 1 mark milta hai.
map_partial: Map mein 4 mein se 3 sahi hain toh 3 marks milenge.
objective_no_explanation: MCQ/fill blank mein sirf answer likhna kaafi — explanation nahi chahiye.

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] pencil_use: Pencil only for map marking and diagram drawing. Answers always in pen. recommendation: Blue pen for main answers, pencil for maps and diagrams.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: long_answer_format: Long answers (Q21-Q22) mein structured points ya short paragraphs likhna zaroori hai. diagram_quality: Q18 soil profile mein neat diagram + labelling se full marks milte hain. Rough diagram se kam marks. map_accuracy: Map mein location approximately sahi honi chahiye. Naam spelling sahi likho. language: Hindi ya English — jo comfortable ho woh use karo. Dono valid hain.
